params.body:
The Sanity Studio for the Schoutteet site (project `o1i7w9ht`, dataset `production`), so the site content and its photos can be edited without a developer.

## What is in it

- Six document types, the ones the site reads: `siteSettings` (opening hours), `homePage` (hero and story), `historyPage` (banner, intro, milestones, photos), `sellPage` (the Aankoop page head), `service` and `person` (team on the contact page). The first four are singletons with a fixed id; the desk structure shows them as single pages, not lists.
- Every text field in five languages (`nl` required; `en`, `fr`, `de`, `es`), plain text only.
- Images with hotspot and crop, and a translated alt text. The site turns the crop and hotspot into CDN URLs.
- Paragraphs, steps and facts carry a `toConfirm` switch and a read-only source, so provisional text stays visible as provisional.
- `CONTRACT.md` fixes the field names the site depends on; `tests/contract.test.ts` fails when a schema drifts from it.
- `studioHost: 'schoutteet'`, so the Studio deploys to https://schoutteet.sanity.studio.

The dataset already holds the site's current content (12 documents, 11 images), imported from the site's `sanity:seed-export`, and the site mirrors it (schoutteet PR #26).

## Checked

- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean.
- `npx vitest run`: 11 passed.
- `npx sanity schema validate`: no errors.
params.title: Schoutteet Sanity Studio: site content and photos, five languages
